test_details.details: Missing buttons: ['Connect to Drone button (id: connectBtn)', 'ARM button (id: armBtn)', 'DISARM button (id: disarmBtn)', 'TAKEOFF button (id: takeoffBtn)', 'LAND button (id: landBtn)', 'RTL button (id: rtlBtn)', 'Set Mode button (id: setModeBtn)', 'GO TO button (id: goToBtn)', 'CLEAR navigation button (id: clearNavigationBtn)']
All required JavaScript files referenced
Connect button should emit 'send_command' with 'connect_drone' command
Button text should change to 'Disconnect' on successful connection
ARM button should show safety confirmation dialog before sending MAV_CMD_COMPONENT_ARM_DISARM(400)
DISARM button should show safety confirmation before sending disarm command
TAKEOFF button should validate altitude (1-1000m) before sending MAV_CMD_NAV_TAKEOFF(22)
LAND button should send MAV_CMD_NAV_LAND(21) for emergency landing
RTL button should send mode change to RTL mode
Mode STABILIZE should send SET_MODE command with mode number 0
Mode ALT_HOLD should send SET_MODE command with mode number 2
Mode POS_HOLD should send SET_MODE command with mode number 16
Mode LOITER should send SET_MODE command with mode number 5
Mode GUIDED should send SET_MODE command with mode number 4
Mode RTL should send SET_MODE command with mode number 6
Mode LAND should send SET_MODE command with mode number 9
Mode AUTO should send SET_MODE command with mode number 3
Mode BRAKE should send SET_MODE command with mode number 17
Coordinates (37.7749, -122.4194) should be accepted and send waypoint command
Invalid coordinates (91.0, -122.4194) should be rejected with error message
Invalid coordinates (37.7749, -181.0) should be rejected with error message
Invalid coordinates (abc, def) should be rejected with error message
CLEAR navigation should cancel current mission and clear waypoints
Center map button should center map view on current drone position
Fly-to toggle should enable/disable click-to-fly mode on map
Request geofence should fetch and display geofence boundaries
Request mission should fetch and display current mission waypoints
Connection establishment should use proper SocketIO 'send_command' structure
Connection termination should use proper SocketIO 'send_command' structure
ARM/DISARM/TAKEOFF/LAND/RTL commands should use proper SocketIO 'send_command' structure
Flight mode change commands should use proper SocketIO 'send_command' structure
Waypoint navigation commands should use proper SocketIO 'send_command' structure
Mission clear commands should use proper SocketIO 'send_command' structure
Map centering commands should use proper SocketIO 'send_command' structure
Geofence data requests should use proper SocketIO 'send_command' structure
Mission data requests should use proper SocketIO 'send_command' structure
Buttons should show appropriate error messages when virtual drone unavailable
System should handle command timeouts gracefully with user feedback
Invalid inputs should be caught and display clear error messages
System should handle network disconnections and attempt reconnection
Button clicks should provide visual feedback within 100ms
SocketIO commands should be sent within 100ms of button click
Virtual drone should acknowledge commands within 5 seconds
System should handle multiple rapid button clicks gracefully
